levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every V2 part file is handed in, named V2_ (or V2A_, V2B_, V2C_) with the student's last name, opens, differs from V1 where the student says it does, and shows no red or yellow marks in the tree.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A real V2 that opens, but the tree carries red or yellow marks, or a name does not follow the pattern.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The file is V1 under a new name, or a piece of a multi-part hook is missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No V2 part file handed in.

criterion: V2: V2 is its own part file, named, and rebuilds; V1 is left as it was

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The whole SolidWorks window with the changed feature or face selected, so it shows highlighted, and a readable tree.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: V2 shows, but nothing is selected, or the tree is cropped.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot uploaded.

criterion: V2: The screenshot shows V2 with the changed feature selected

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every row measured on V2, every row inside its rule or carrying a fix, and the full-size weight read off the slicer at 50.0 g or under.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One row unmeasured, one miss without a fix, or no weight, or the weight is over 50.0 g with no plan.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The numbers repeat the rules rather than V2, or two or more rows are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing measured.

criterion: V2: Every dimension and the full-size weight are measured on V2

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Where Test 1 broke is picked, and the change is at that place, named on the part, with the size it changed by.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The change is at the break, but how much it changed is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A change was made, but not where Test 1 broke, and no reason is given.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.

criterion: V2: The change is at the place Test 1 broke, and says so

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A reason the change helps at that spot, and what should happen at the next pull.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Says it will be stronger without saying why.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.

criterion: V2: Says what the change should do to the break

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Picks what it cost and says where the grams came from, or why it cost nothing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Picks a cost without saying where from or why.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing picked or written.

criterion: V2: Accounts for what the change cost in weight

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both screenshots show a small split face in the top loop and one in the bowl, the fixture on the top split face only, and the load on the bowl split face only, Normal, pointing down, reading 400 lbf.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Set up and run, with one thing off: a fixture or load on a whole face instead of the split face, units in N, or the load arrows pointing up.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A study exists, but two or more of the split faces, fixture, load face, direction or units are wrong or cannot be seen.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Neither setup screenshot handed in.

criterion: Simulate: The study is set up right: split faces, fixture on the top face, 400 lbf down on the bowl face

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A screenshot of the von Mises stress plot of V2 after Run, with the hook and the color scale both readable.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The stress plot of V2, but the color scale is cut off or the hook is too small to read.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A plot handed in, but it is displacement or strain, or it is not V2.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No stress plot handed in.

criterion: Simulate: The stress plot is handed in with its color scale

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Picks where the most red is, it agrees with the plot, and says whether that is where Test 1 broke.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Picks where the red is and it agrees with the plot, but does not compare it with Test 1.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Picks a place, but the plot shows the most red somewhere else.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing picked.

criterion: Simulate: Names where the red is and compares it with where Test 1 broke

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Says what V3 changes, adds material where the plot is red, and names where the plot is blue as the place the grams come from.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A V3 change tied to the plot, but only to the red or only to the blue.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A V3 change that does not use what the plot shows.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.

criterion: Simulate: The V3 plan uses the plot: material added at the red, taken from the blue

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every V3 part file is handed in, named V3_ (or V3A_, V3B_, V3C_) with the student's last name, differs from V2 at the spot the stress plot showed red, and the sentence says what changed there and where the grams came from.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A real V3 changed at the red, but the sentence leaves out what changed or where the grams came from, or a name does not follow the pattern.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A V3 file that is V2 renamed, or changed somewhere the plot did not show red, with no reason given.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No V3 part file handed in.

criterion: V3 and your call: V3 is its own part file, named, built at the red, and the change is explained

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The full-size weight read off the slicer with V3 alone on the plate, 50.0 g or under, and the wall loops and infill it was sliced with are named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A full-size weight, but the settings are not named, or it is over 50.0 g with a plan to take grams off.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A weight that is half size, or the whole team plate, or over 50.0 g with no plan.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No weight.

criterion: V3 and your call: V3 is weighed alone at full size with its own print settings named

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A load in lb, a spot where V3 will break, and a reason for both that uses the student's own tests, the stress plot or both.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A load and a spot, but the reason does not use a test or the plot.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only a load, or only a spot.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing called.

criterion: V3 and your call: The call is a load and a spot, with a reason from the tests or the plot

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The screenshot shows the sliced plate with both team hooks (or one hook, printing alone, said so), each on its owner's settings, and the printer it is on is named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The plate is in and printing, but one hook is on the default settings, or the partner or printer is not named.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A plate screenshot that is not sliced, or no printer named.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No plate screenshot.

criterion: V3 and your call: The team plate is sliced with each hook on its owner's settings, and printing

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Says what happened to the hook, the most it held in lb from the scale, and where it broke (or that it never broke).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: What happened is there, but the load or the spot is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Says what happened and nothing else.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing picked.

criterion: What happened: The result is recorded: what happened, the load it held and where it broke

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A close photo of the student's own hook with the broken face in focus (or the whole hook, if it never broke).

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A photo, but the break is too far away or blurry to read, or it is not this student's hook.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No photo.

criterion: What happened: A close photo of this student's own break

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Says plainly whether the call was right on the load and on the spot, and gives a reason for what happened. Right or wrong scores the same.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Compares the load and the spot, but gives no reason.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Compares only the load, or only the spot.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written, or no comparison to the call.

criterion: What happened: Compares the call to what happened, on the load and on the spot, with a reason

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names one change, where on the part it goes, and ties it to the break or the load.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A change with no place on the part, or with no reason.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.

criterion: What happened: One change for V4, at a named place, tied to what the break showed

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The screenshot shows the student's slide with the hook and student name, the load in lb, a CAD image, the stress plot with its color scale, a photo of the printed hook and a slicer view.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The slide is in the deck with four or five of the six things.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A slide started, with three or fewer of the six.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot of a slide.

criterion: What happened: One slide in the IDEA Hook Designs deck carrying all six things
